exams.name: Commissioner's examination
exams.notes: Applicants must complete 12 hours of prelicensing education before taking the exam. If applicant fails reexamination, must file new application and wait one year before re-examination.
exams.quote: Each applicant for a license as a professional bondsman, surety bondsman, or runner shall appear in person and take an examination prepared by the Commissioner testing the applicant's ability and qualifications.

interval_years.quote: A license of a bail bondsman and a license of a runner shall be renewed on July 1 of each even year upon payment of the applicable biennial renewal fee.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The renewal fee for a bail bondsman's license is two hundred dollars ($200.00).

required.quote: Each year by June 30 every licensee shall complete at least three hours of continuing education as provided by an approved provider in subjects related to the duties and responsibilities of a runner or bail bondsman.

period_years.quote: Each year by June 30 every licensee shall complete at least three hours of continuing education

available.quote: an occupational licensing board or a State agency licensing board subject to this section shall issue a license, certification, or registration to any applicant who establishes residence in this State

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, or West Virginia at the same or substantially equivalent level, licensed for at least one year, passed required examination, be in good standing, have no disqualifying criminal history, and pay applicable fees.
requirements.quote: The applicant is currently licensed, certified, or registered in Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, or West Virginia in the discipline applied for in this State at the same or substantially equivalent practice level

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor committed in the course of dealings under the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of any misdemeanor committed in the course of dealings under the license issued by the Commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement, misrepresentation or fraud in obtaining the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misstatement, misrepresentation or fraud in obtaining the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriation, conversion or unlawful withholding of moneys belonging to insurers or others received in the conduct of business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misappropriation, conversion or unlawful withholding of moneys belonging to insurers or others and received in the conduct of business under the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices in the conduct of business or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in the conduct of business in this State or any other jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty, breach of trust, or moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty, breach of trust, or moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with or violation of provisions of this Article or any order, subpoena, rule or regulation of the Commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with or violation of the provisions of this Article or of any order, subpoena, rule or regulation of the Commissioner or person with similar regulatory authority in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated incompetency, financial irresponsibility, or untrustworthiness; or guilty of rebating or offering to divide premiums.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee has in the conduct of the licensee's affairs under the license, demonstrated incompetency, financial irresponsibility, or untrustworthiness; or that the licensee is no longer in good faith carrying on the bail bond business; or that the licensee is guilty of rebating, or offering to rebate, or offering to divide the premiums received for the bond.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay any judgment or decree rendered on any forfeited undertaking in any court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For failing to pay any judgment or decree rendered on any forfeited undertaking in any court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging or receiving premium or compensation in excess of that permitted by this Article.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For charging or receiving, as premium or compensation for the making of any deposit or bail bond, any sum in excess of that permitted by this Article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring as a condition of executing a bail bond that the principal agree to engage the services of a specified attorney.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For requiring, as a condition of executing a bail bond, that the principal agree to engage the services of a specified attorney.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on an examination for a license under this Article.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For cheating on an examination for a license under this Article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into business association with any person found in violation of or disqualified under bail bond laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For entering into any business association or agreement with any person who is at that time found by the Commissioner to be in violation of any of the bail bond laws of this State, or who has been in any manner disqualified under the bail bond laws of this State or any other state, whereby the person has any direct or indirect financial interest in the bail bond business of the licensee or applicant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting others to evade or violate the provisions of this Article.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For knowingly aiding or abetting others to evade or violate the provisions of this Article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having any professional license denied, suspended, or revoked in this State or any other jurisdiction for substantially similar causes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having any professional license denied, suspended, or revoked in this State or any other jurisdiction for causes substantially similar to those listed in this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any law governing bail bonding or insurance in this State or any other jurisdiction, or any FINRA rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of (i) any law governing bail bonding or insurance in this State or any other jurisdiction or (ii) any rule of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation after entry of a final judgment finding the violation willful.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an administrative order or court order imposing a child support obligation after entry of a final judgment or order finding the violation to have been willful.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay State or federal income tax or any liens resulting from such failure after entry of a final judgment directing payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay State or federal income tax or any liens that result from such failure to comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of State or federal income tax after entry of a final judgment or order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to any document related to a bail bond transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging another's name to any document related to a bail bond transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee is or has ever been convicted of a felony — mandatory denial or revocation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Commissioner shall deny, revoke, or refuse to renew any license under this Article if the applicant or licensee is or has ever been convicted of a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor drug violation under Article 5 of Chapter 90 — mandatory revocation if on or after October 1, 2009.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Commissioner shall revoke or refuse to renew any license under this Article if the licensee has been convicted on or after October 1, 2009, of a misdemeanor drug violation under Article 5 of Chapter 90 of the General Statutes.

definition_quote.value: Bail bondsman. - A surety bondsman, professional bondsman or an accommodation bondsman as defined in this section.
definition_quote.quote: Bail bondsman. - A surety bondsman, professional bondsman or an accommodation bondsman as defined in this section.

value: pledging cash or approved securities as security for bail bonds
apprehending and surrendering defendants to court
presenting defendants in court when required
methods_authorized.quote: Runner. - A person employed by a bail bondsman for the purpose of assisting the bail bondsman in presenting the defendant in court when required, assisting in the apprehension and surrender of defendant to the court, keeping the defendant under necessary surveillance, or executing bonds on behalf of the licensed bondsman when the power of attorney has been duly recorded.

agent_type_tiers.quote: Bail bondsman. - A surety bondsman, professional bondsman or an accommodation bondsman as defined in this section.

runner_license_available.quote: Runner. - A person employed by a bail bondsman for the purpose of assisting the bail bondsman in presenting the defendant in court when required, assisting in the apprehension and surrender of defendant to the court, keeping the defendant under necessary surveillance, or executing bonds on behalf of the licensed bondsman when the power of attorney has been duly recorded.

first_year_supervision_required.quote: a first-year licensee shall operate only under the supervision of and from the official business address of a licensed supervising bail bondsman for the first 12 months of licensure.

first_year_supervision_duration_months.quote: a first-year licensee shall operate only under the supervision of and from the official business address of a licensed supervising bail bondsman for the first 12 months of licensure.

power_of_attorney_required.quote: a surety bondsman shall register his or her current surety bondsman's license and a certified copy of his or her power of appointment with the clerk of superior court in the county in which the surety bondsman resides

premium_rate_percentage.quote: Accept anything of value from a principal or from anyone on behalf of a principal except the premium, which shall not exceed fifteen percent (15%) of the face amount of the bond

premium_financing_allowed.quote: In any case where the agreement between principal and surety calls for some portion of the bond premium payments to be deferred or paid after the defendant has been released from custody, a written memorandum of agreement between the principal and surety shall be kept on file by the surety

collateral_receipt_required.quote: When a bail bondsman accepts collateral he shall give a written receipt for the collateral. The receipt shall give in detail a full description of the collateral received.

collateral_held_in_fiduciary_capacity.quote: Collateral security shall be held and maintained in trust.

collateral_return_deadline_days.quote: Such collateral security or other indemnity required by the bondsman must be reasonable in relation to the amount of the bond and shall be returned within 15 days after final termination of liability on the bond.

value: any place where prisoners are confined
solicitation_restrictions.quote: Solicit business in any of the courts or on the premises of any of the courts of this State, in the office of any magistrate and in or about any place where prisoners are confined.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: Participate in the capacity of an attorney at a trial or hearing of one on whose bond he is surety, nor suggest or advise the employment of, or name for employment any particular attorney to represent his principal.

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value, directly or indirectly, to a jailer, law-enforcement officer, committing magistrate, or any other person who has power to arrest or hold in custody, or to any public official or public employee in order to secure a settlement, compromise, remission or reduction of the amount of any bail bond or the forfeiture thereof

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: At any time before there has been a breach of the undertaking in any type of bail or fine and cash bond the surety may surrender the defendant to the sheriff of the county in which the defendant is bonded to appear or to the sheriff where the defendant was bonded

security_deposit_required_for_company.quote: Each professional bondsman acting as surety on bail bonds in this State shall maintain a deposit of securities with and satisfactory to the Commissioner

security_deposit_minimum_amount.quote: the value of said deposit shall in no event be less than fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000)

quarterly_bond_reporting_required.quote: Each insurer that appoints surety bondsmen in this State shall file with the Commissioner a written report in a form adopted by the Commissioner regarding all bail bonds on which the insurer is liable as of the last day of each calendar quarter

bond_register_required.quote: All records related to executing bail bonds, including bail bond registers, monthly reports, receipts, collateral security agreements, and memoranda of agreements, shall be kept separate from records of any other business

record_retention_period_years.quote: must be maintained for not less than three years after the final entry has been made.

premium_trust_account_required.quote: When collateral security is received in the form of cash or check or other negotiable instrument, the licensee shall deposit the cash or instrument within two banking days after receipt, in an established, separate noninterest-bearing trust account in any bank located in North Carolina. The trust account funds under this section shall not be commingled with other operating funds.

statewide_registry_of_licensees.quote: the Administrative Office of the Courts shall establish a statewide Electronic Bondsmen Registry (Registry) for all licenses requiring registration under this section.

residency_requirement.quote: Resident. - A person who lives in this State for at least six consecutive months immediately before applying for a license under this Article.

citizenship_or_work_authorization_requir.quote: Be a legal resident or a documented citizen of the United States of America.

high_school_diploma_required.quote: Have obtained a high school diploma or its equivalent.

value: misdemeanor drug violation under Article 5 of Chapter 90 within previous 24 months (denial) or on or after October 1, 2009 (revocation/nonrenewal)
disqualifying_criminal_offenses.quote: The Commissioner shall deny, revoke, or refuse to renew any license under this Article if the applicant or licensee is or has ever been convicted of a felony.

prelicense_education_hours.quote: each person shall complete at least 12 hours of education as provided by an approved provider in subjects pertinent to the duties and responsibilities of a runner or bail bondsman

continuing_education_hours_per_period.quote: Each year by June 30 every licensee shall complete at least three hours of continuing education

continuing_education_period_years.quote: Each year by June 30 every licensee shall complete at least three hours of continuing education

continuing_education_exemption_for_senio.quote: A licensed runner or bail bondsman who is 65 years of age or older and who has been licensed as a runner or bail bondsman for 15 years or more is exempt from both the prelicensing education and continuing education requirements of this section.

online_education_prohibited.quote: The Commissioner shall not authorize educational courses to be offered solely online.

agency_ownership_experience_requirement.quote: A first-year licensed bail bondsman is prohibited from becoming a supervising bail bondsman during the first two years of licensure.

bondsman_access_to_court_records.quote: the Administrative Office of the Courts shall provide any individual with a current license to act as professional bondsman, surety bondsman, or runner with access to search criminal records in the Administrative Office of the Courts' real-time criminal and civil information systems.
